entities.summary: Perng Shaw-jiin (b. 1957-02-28, Beipu Township) was a educator or academic of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Beipu Township and Taiwan. Known in the fields of taiwan, legal figures, asia.
